notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843354/c371a83b542d74e1475d3f3a302b33a0126aac92.png
Introducing the Portal Sword:

Put down the fish gun and wield the all-new Portal Sword! This legendary weapon harnesses the power of interdimensional portals to slash through enemies with unparalleled precision and strength. Immerse yourself in fast-paced hack-and-slash action as you carve your way through hordes of foes across all 50 levels of intense gameplay.

Pete Portal Power:

Each Pete Portal you carry empowers the Portal Sword, enhancing its capabilities and unleashing devastating attacks upon your enemies. Strategically collect and utilize Pete Portals to amplify your sword's power and overcome even the most formidable adversaries that stand in your path.

Don't miss out on the excitement! Wield the power of the Portal Sword and embark on the adventure of a lifetime.

notes.title: Let The Bodies Hit The Floor Update
notes.notes:
Post-Mortem Enemy Animations: Now,  defeated foes can crumble into over 11 unique animations, adding a satisfying touch to your victories.

Pete Portal Pick Ups: the new Pete Portal pick up system lets you hold up to 3 Portals.

Hard mode offers:

 Increased Challenge: Brace yourself for a tougher playthrough. Enemies are faster and stronger, requiring sharper reflexes and strategic thinking.

 Obstacle Overhaul: New level obstacles will test your skills. Find creative ways to advance.

 Explosive Boomer Action: The boomer explosions are now bigger and more impactful.

 Fleeting Fey Air Waves: The mystical air waves that once lingered now dissipate quickly. Time your movements carefully to harness their power.

 Dynamic Level Layouts: Some levels have undergone changes. Adapt to the unexpected twists and turns as you progress.


And of course, I squashed pesky bugs to ensure a smoother gaming experience. Get ready to dive back in and conquer the challenges.
